verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process");const die=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const studio=fs.readdirSync("app/(main)/admin/appearance").filter(f=>/\.tsx?$/.test(f)).map(f=>fs.readFileSync("app/(main)/admin/appearance/"+f,"utf8")).join("\n");if(!/generation/i.test(studio))die("Theme Studio (app/(main)/admin/appearance) never mentions generation, so an operator cannot change it");const r=fs.readFileSync("lib/theme/server/resolve.ts","utf8");const css=fs.readFileSync("app/globals.css","utf8");if(/FOLLOW-UP \(deliberately NOT done here\): per-preset contrast/.test(css))die("app/globals.css still describes per-preset contrast tuning as not done");const reg=fs.readFileSync("lib/theme/generations.ts","utf8");for(const m of reg.matchAll(/id:\s*\x27([a-z-]+)\x27[\s\S]*?minContrast:\s*\x27(AAA|AA)\x27/g)){if(m[2]==="AAA"&&!css.includes("[data-generation=\""+m[1]+"\"]")||m[2]==="AAA"&&!new RegExp(":is\\(html, \\[data-skin\\]\\)\\[data-generation=\""+m[1]+"\"\\]").test(css))die("AAA preset "+m[1]+" has no tuned ink block in app/globals.css")}const out=cp.spawnSync("node",["scripts/check-contrast.mjs"],{encoding:"utf8"});if(out.status!==0)die("check:contrast fails:\n"+(out.stderr||out.stdout).slice(0,800));if(!/· spacious/.test(out.stdout))die("check:contrast does not measure the AAA presets as their own states")'
